articles.title: Study showed MiniMed™ 780G system achieved ADA-recommended time-in-range goals even on days users forgot to bolus
articles.mainIdea: Study showed MiniMed™ 780G system achieved ADA-recommended time-in-range goals even on days users forgot to bolus
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Study showed MiniMed™ 780G system achieved ADA-recommended time-in-range goals even on days users forgot to bolus. A new real-world retrospective analysis published in Diabetes Care showed that users of the MiniMed™ 780G system achieved American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommended goals for time-in-range (TIR)— even on days when mealtime boluses were missed. CareLink™ data showed that the studied user population achieved 76.3% TIR on missed bolus days when using SmartGuard™ technology with recommended optimal settings (100 mg/dL glucose target; two-hour active insulin time).
